versions.changelog: Makes first-run setup aware of each connection's actual spending authority. SpendCap now recommends valid limits, defaults within the connection maximum, validates before submission, and shows clear guidance while preserving fail-closed server enforcement.

Launches SpendCap: set hard per-purchase and daily spending limits for AI agents, approve exceptions, pause or revoke access, and get signed proof of purchases made through Receipt. Setup makes no purchase and uses the existing Receipt connection.
